summary: The anchor half of machine/overlay_map.json's additive_overlay_then_anchor_based_integration has been performed for the live message path, the ordinary-user model path, the Owner capability boundary, the canonical write path, the setup portal and the operations projection. Seven of thirty-six modules remain outside the live require graph and are named individually below. Nothing here is claimed as done that was not measured.

measurement.method: transitive require-graph walk from bin/cyberboss.js, the entrypoint the operator runs, excluding test/ which is not an entrypoint
measurement.script: recomputed at closure time; the walk resolves every relative require and follows it

what_is_now_live.inbound_admission: src/core/app.js#handleIncomingMessage resolves a server-owned UserContext from the bot account and sender before any command is parsed, any workspace is bound or any runtime is reached. An unknown sender gets the invite prompt; a pending sender gets consent; a suspended or deleting user is refused. Every pre-active reply costs zero model calls, and that count is asserted by driving a real message through the real method.
what_is_now_live.ordinary_user_model_path: src/core/user-turn-runtime.js assembles the CB-700 stack — credential vault, budget guard, circuit breaker, provider router, controller, fair queue — and runs an ordinary user's turn through it. The Owner runtime adapters are never reached on this path.
what_is_now_live.owner_boundary: dispatchPreparedTurn refuses a turn that reaches the Owner runtime without an Owner context, and tool-host.js consults the active runtime context when an MCP tool call carries none of its own. Both are refusals, not downgrades.
what_is_now_live.channel_allowlist: with admission on, CYBERBOSS_ALLOWED_USER_IDS stops being a channel filter and becomes the Owner set. The 32 KiB input limit still applies to every sender.
what_is_now_live.setup_page: 「设置」 mints a single-use 15-minute token, puts it in the URL fragment so it never reaches a server or proxy access log, and the SetupPortal's nine frozen actions are bound to the real vault, profile store, exporter, deletion planner and import ledger.
what_is_now_live.canonical_write_path: canonical-sync.js runs the envelope's own forbidden-field and secret-value scan before an event can be staged. It calls that scan rather than reimplementing the rule.
what_is_now_live.operations: doctor prints the fourteen-line business matrix, the resource gate verdict measured from the host, the self-heal decision and the eleven zero-agent counters. A dependency that is genuinely unconfigured reports activation_pending with a reason code.

still_not_reachable_from_the_entrypoint.note: the user-scoped timeline, diary and reminder reads still run on the pre-existing single-user services. UserScopedRepository is proved at CB-630 but nothing on the live path constructs one yet.
no scheduled analytics pass exists on the live path.
the companion loop is not started; an ordinary user's turn is answered by the provider without it.
the existing check-in poller is the Owner's; the per-user deterministic check-in is not scheduled.
needs a real Cloudflare R2 bucket credential and a real OCI pre-authenticated request. Already carried as activation_pending by PG-8; unchanged.
operates on the authorised target host during a release. Already carried as activation_pending by PG-8; unchanged.
runs as uid 0 from /usr/local/sbin/cyberbossctl on the target host, deliberately not from the app process. Already carried as activation_pending by PG-8; unchanged.

accounting.note: the three credential-blocked modules were already outstanding before this work and are not newly claimed. The four wiring items are the honest remainder of the anchor half.

verification_performed.app_suite: 497 pass / 0 fail (474 before the integration, 489 after the first anchor, 497 after the portal handlers)
new_suites: test/inbound-user-admission-e2e.test.js — drives a simulated inbound WeChat message through CyberbossApp#handleIncomingMessage against a real SQLite runtime database and counts provider and Owner-runtime calls

test/portal-handlers-e2e.test.js — takes the single-use link, exchanges it for a session, saves a real key through the production SetupPortal, and asserts the same user's next turn reaches that provider
verification_performed.live_boot: a fresh state directory applies migrations 1-7, derives the Owner user id, and takes a stranger through invite -> consent -> scoped user with may(codex.turn) === false. doctor emits fourteen business lines and model_calls 0.
verification_performed.counts_are_measured_not_declared: every count in this file was recomputed at closure time; none is restated from a summary.

what_this_does_not_claim.product_acceptance: PG-8 remains CONDITIONAL_PASS. AC-035, AC-039, AC-040 and AC-050 are still outstanding for the same reason as before: the credentials and the authorised target host are not in scope here.
what_this_does_not_claim.ac_039: still no part of it is claimed. Two real WeChat senders have never registered against a real channel credential.
what_this_does_not_claim.live_provider_activation: no real BYOK provider key has been exercised against a real provider endpoint. The provider path is proved against a fake transport that records the origin and the authorization header.
what_this_does_not_claim.target_environment: no code in this Subject has run on the authorised OVH target.

recorded_because: the goal directive forbids 伪完成. The gap file said the overlay was built but not live; this file says exactly how much of it is live now, and names what still is not.
